objective: Provide a clean provider-neutral extension base for adding code families to the Code Capability Fabric one reviewed lane at a time.

requirements.acceptance: Exact language, specialist, recipe, builder, evidence, and zero-authority boundaries are byte-bound.
Unknown, duplicated, inactive, ambiguous, or drifted bindings fail closed without fallback.
Consent binds the build-profile catalog and selected profile digests in addition to intent, request, recipe catalog, and recipe bytes.
Only a registered exact profile may reach the existing in-memory detached-candidate builder.
A classified language with no reviewed recipe remains a typed gap rather than borrowing a nearby lane.
Outside this rung and not authorized.
